issue: `pip` is not installed on this machine; PyMuPDF 1.28.2, numpy 2.5.3 and qpdf 12.4.2 are already present; Pillow is not
action: Nothing to install. Page renders for inspection are made with PyMuPDF only (`scripts/cs/render_pages.py`)

issue: Liberation Sans (used by the Chemistry book) is not installed
action: Generated text (cover, headers, references, index) uses Noto Sans; `layout.py` picks Liberation Sans when it is present

issue: The spec lists s22, every March series and w26 as not on the site
action: All of them were still requested (so each is logged as unavailable): m21-m26 (variants 12, 22), s22, w26. All answer with a redirect, not a PDF

issue: O/N 2022 (9618) is on the site although the spec's list of found series does not name it
action: Downloaded, header-verified and included like the other series (spec: verify every paper by download)

issue: The 9618 PDFs carry the site's tiled logo and a footer block (rule, site name, invisible lines ending in a trace ID)
action: Stripped in memory when a file is loaded (`parse.strip_watermark`); the files in data/ are left untouched

issue: 9618 papers print no [Total: n] per question
action: The part [marks] must add up to the cover total (75); a printed [Total: n] would also be checked. A question ends where the next one starts; the last question ends just below its last [mark]

issue: Bracketed numbers also occur inside questions (array elements such as `Sales[4]`, trace-table headings)
action: Only a `[n]` right-aligned at the right-hand margin counts as a mark

issue: CS papers use dots both for answer lines and for gaps inside code, sentences and table cells that the candidate must fill
action: Answer lines (a run at least 250 pt wide, or running to the right-hand margin on a line with little other text) are removed from the picture and the text layer. Short runs inside code, a sentence or a table cell are kept as printed

issue: The Chemistry reader treats the word "Total" in the answer column as a total row; CS answers contain identifiers named `Total`
action: That rule is removed for CS (9618 mark schemes print no question totals)

issue: The spec asks for the part that defines an identifier to be shown with any item that uses it
action: Identifiers are found from the text layer: words set in the monospace font (character advance 0.6 em) that are not keywords, built-in functions or literals, plus `Name()`, CamelCase, `UPPER_SNAKE` and `File.txt` names in ordinary text. The definition site is the first part of the question, in paper order, that uses the name; an item using it gets that part as context (question crop only)

issue: Papers do not number figures or tables; a later part says "the algorithm", "this flowchart", "the company" about something an earlier part introduced
action: When an item uses "the/this/these <noun>" for a noun that neither the stem nor the item introduces, the earlier part that first has the noun is added as context. Very general nouns (data, user, computer, program, table, file ...) are not treated this way

issue: Every 9618 Paper 2 prints "Refer to the insert for the list of pseudocode functions and operators" once, above Question 1; that line is not part of any item
action: The insert note or inline pages go to an item whose own text refers to the insert, and to an item that uses a function its own insert defines and the Appendix copy does not (LCASE, UCASE, NOW in 2021). All other items rely on the Appendix

issue: The 2024-25 inserts differ from the 2026 insert only by a colon after one "Example" and a full stop after "records"
action: "Matches in text" ignores punctuation at the end of a word (and white space, footers and the copyright paragraph). M/J 24, M/J 25, O/N 25 and M/J 26 inserts match the Appendix copy; 2021, 2022, 2023 and O/N 24 inserts differ

issue: "The insert of the newest paper": the three M/J 26 inserts have the same text
action: The insert of M/J 26/P23 is used (newest series, highest variant, as in the Chemistry build)

issue: The spec asks that code, tables, trace tables and diagrams never split across pages; CS papers print no captions
action: A figure is a run of consecutive monospace lines or a cluster of drawings/images with the text inside it; all its crop bands are kept on one page. Only a figure taller than a page can break

issue: The spec asks for unit, section and learning outcome per part
action: Learning outcomes are the "Candidates should be able to" statements of `λ-cs/cs-syllabus.pdf`, extracted by `scripts/cs/syllabus.py` and numbered in print order (1.2.3 = third outcome of section 1.2). A tag is one such id

issue: The book serves a student and Claude teaching the student
action: Besides the Chemistry fields, each line also has the sections, learning-outcome ids, answer page and the answer text from the mark scheme's text layer

issue: Many Paper 2 parts touch several learning outcomes at once (a module that reads a file into an array with string functions)
action: One rule for every part and for the blind re-tag: a part that writes or completes a module is tagged by the first that applies: text-file handling 10.3.2; array processing 10.2.3 / 10.2.4 (search, sort); stack, queue or linked list 10.4.x; otherwise procedure 11.3.1 or function 11.3.4. Trace tables / dry runs 12.3.4; flowchart from a description 9.2.7; pseudocode from a flowchart or numbered steps 9.2.6; an algorithm described in steps or structured English 9.2.5; complete algorithm from a description 9.2.4; evaluating or completing expressions with built-in functions 11.1.3, with operators only 11.1.2; a logic statement written from a problem condition 9.2.9

issue: Parts asking for features that make code easier to read (meaningful names, indentation, comments) have no learning outcome of their own
action: Tagged 9.2.2 (use suitable identifier names), the nearest outcome; kept in the Paper 2 book

item: Tagging: Paper 2 parts on Paper 1 topics
issue: Some Paper 2 parts test a unit 1-8 outcome: IDE debugging features (5.2.4), validation checks and check digits (6.2.2)
action: Tagged with that outcome and filed in the Paper 1 book (spec: a part is filed by its topic, not its paper); each is listed under "Parts filed by topic in the other paper's book". Library routines in Paper 2 stay under 11.1.3 (use built-in functions and library routines)

issue: In 2021 the variant 1 and variant 3 papers have the same text: M/J 21 P11 = P13, M/J 21 P21 = P23, O/N 21 P11 = P13, O/N 21 P21 = P23
action: Both papers of each pair are kept (each is a separate official paper with its own reference); their parts carry the same tags, so their items sit next to each other in a unit

issue: The spec lists the 9608 series found on the site
action: All series 2015-2021 were requested, including March (variants 12, 22), w20 and the w15/w21 variants the spec lists as missing. Not on the site: every March series, w20 (all), w15 QP 12, w21 QPs 12, 13, 21, 22, 23 (their mark schemes exist but are not used)

issue: Many 9608 mark schemes print "Paper 1 Written Paper" / "Paper 2 Written Paper" (63 files), and two print "Paper 2" with no title (M/J 17 P21, P23)
action: Accepted (paper number, code/variant, series and document type match); each wording is counted in the table below

issue: The mark scheme of 9608/21 prints "Paper 1 Written Paper": wrong paper number
action: Paper excluded by the header rule (as Chemistry decision D5)

issue: The question paper file on the site is damaged (truncated at 475 136 bytes; the same on a second download; PyMuPDF and qpdf cannot read it)
action: Paper excluded

issue: In M/J 21 and O/N 21 both syllabuses sat papers with the same variant numbers, so "M/J 21/P11/Q3/a" would name two different parts
action: The seven 9608 papers of 2021 carry the code from their header in the reference: "9608 M/J 21/P11/Q3/a". All other references are unchanged

issue: They are printed as running text, not as a table ("2 (a) (i) Any one from: ... [1]")
action: A second reader (`parse.ms_rows_text`): a row starts at a part label at the start of a line, in the order of the question paper's own parts, and runs to the next label; marks are the [n] at the right-hand margin; "max n" is the row's mark, counted once when it is repeated under alternative solutions. Every question still has to pass check 3 and every item the [marks] = MS marks check

item: Marks not at the right-hand margin (9608)
issue: A few 9608 papers print a mark beside a short answer line in the middle of the page, as two words ("[1" "]"), or level with the footer
action: Split marks are joined; a mark that ends a dotted answer line counts; a lone [n] short of the margin counts only when the paper total cannot be reached without it (M/J 15 P21/P22: 1 mark; M/J 17 P12: 4 marks; logged per paper)

issue: Numbered pseudocode lines at the left margin look like question numbers
action: A question number is never zero-padded and never set in the monospace font

issue: Some 2018 mark schemes repeat a row's label and mark on the next page
action: A mark repeated under the same label on a later page counts once

issue: 9608 Paper 2 prints the built-in functions as an "Appendix" inside the question paper (one or two pages) instead of an insert
action: Those pages are not question material. They are treated as the paper's insert: an item whose text refers to the Appendix shows its own paper's Appendix page(s) inline under a grey note, because that text differs from the book's Appendix (the 2026 insert)

issue: 9608 asks for program code in Visual Basic, Pascal or Python; the 2027-29 Paper 2 outcomes speak of pseudocode
action: Included and tagged by the skill tested (file handling, arrays, procedures, functions ...), as the spec's rule on "Write program code" answers implies. Where the mark scheme prints the program-code solutions in its own appendix ("Q6 (a): Visual Basic" ...), that appendix section is appended to the part's answer rows, so the answer is whole

issue: Topics of 9608 with no clear match in the 2027-29 outcomes
action: Excluded and listed: client- and server-side scripting (JavaScript, PHP, HTML), video (frame rate, interlaced/progressive encoding, spatial/temporal redundancy), features of sound- and graphics-editing software, devices not in the 3.1 list (keyboard, mouse, trackerball, scanner, inkjet printer), gateways, URL encoding characters, the three-level database schema, disk mirroring, assembler macros and directives, the named principles of the ACM/IEEE code of ethics, "transferable skills" and reading code in an unfamiliar language, numeric formatting masks, error detection and recovery as an OS task

issue: The spec excludes parts that need pre-release material
action: No part of the downloaded 9608 Paper 2 papers refers to pre-release material in its text; none was excluded for this reason

item: Parts whose context would exceed one page
issue: The spec says to keep the lettered part whole or exclude; in CS the context is often a whole earlier part (a flowchart, a module table)
action: "About one page" is one page of the book (744 pt). A part whose context would be longer is merged with the parts it depends on into one block, filed under the unit with most marks and tagged "also" (listed under multi-unit parts kept whole). Excluded only if that is not possible

issue: Some papers print the copyright paragraph at the foot of a question page
action: Treated as page furniture: not part of any crop or text
